fragmentation.limitation: multiple logical files may share a bucket; uniform physical-file selection approximates their Zipf ranks

phase_zipf.scope: fixed ranks within original business group or logical size class

provenance.adaptation: SES 1.2.0 template-based storage workload with original read/write shares and added conditional Zipf; not standard SES certification

idfs_expansion.coverage: 600s timed access, not complete scans; generated probabilities do not guarantee measured object heat or classifier metrics
idfs_expansion.method: increase logical file counts; keep logical size classes, timing, business shares and source read/write types; rebuild conditional Zipf bins
idfs_expansion.runtime: unmodified Vdbench 5.04.07; integer transfer percentages; no SES framework

provenance.operation_mapping: preserve source reads and writes; overwrite prepared synthetic files
